INSERT INTO block_manifest_verification_task (
            generation,
            local_manifest_id,
            eligible_at,
            next_attempt_at,
            retry_delay_micros,
            max_attempts
        )
        SELECT manifest.generation,
            manifest.id,
            NOW() + $2::BIGINT * INTERVAL '1 microsecond',
            NOW() + $2::BIGINT * INTERVAL '1 microsecond',
            $3, $4
          FROM block_manifest manifest
         WHERE manifest.id = $1
        ON CONFLICT (local_manifest_id, generation) DO NOTHING
        RETURNING id
